blockingFindings.title: Retry cannot resume journal-only completed intent state
blockingFindings.issue: `commitOwnedImplRepairEffects()` clears the flow-state intent before deleting `impl-repair-transaction.json`, but `completeTestEvidenceRefresh()` only resumes a pending transaction from `activeState.implRepairTransaction`. If a crash occurs at `after-intent-completion`, the next refresh builds a new transaction and then `commitOwnedTestEvidenceRefresh()` rejects the remaining journal as different instead of reconciling and removing it.
blockingFindings.suggestion: In `completeTestEvidenceRefresh()` or `commitOwnedTestEvidenceRefresh()`, when `activeState.implRepairTransaction` is absent but `impl-repair-transaction.json` exists, load that journal, validate target/source/fingerprints, and run `CommittedImplRepairEffects.reconcileJournal()` before creating a fresh transaction.
blockingFindings.rationale: R5 requires every durable effects boundary to converge exactly once. The implementation added an `after-intent-completion` boundary, but the production resume path still cannot converge the journal-only state where durable effects and intent completion succeeded while journal deletion failed.
